notes.title: Big Update: Interaction with NPCs
notes.notes:
[p]Today the first big update of Tavern Legends comes out.[/p][p][/p][h1]New main features:[/h1][p][/p][h2]Interaction and talking with NPCs[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/92abce71867596d42c6b7bef6a78fc3088e9c7dc.png"][/img]You can now talk to the townsfolk, trade various items with them, ask for a reservation in your tavern and much more.[/p][p]Some of these fine folk even have quests waiting, so don't be shy, being social might just pay off![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/0edfdf308d29b00d2adc0fced7e8cb0e1b6c2e88.png"][/img]The town now boasts a hardworking carpenter, mostly hammering away to add some lively ambience. But more unique peasants are on the way, each bringing their own quirks and charm to your bustling streets.[/p][p][/p][h2]A new worker: The Doorman[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/3d6c34e03086be88a2f56864b2dd63b0a1be875d.png"][/img]Ask guards, if they want to work for you as a doorman![/p][p]Talk to the town guards and see if they’ll take the job. A doorman keeps your tavern safe, and if trouble starts, he’ll step in without costing you a drop of fame.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/47fc3ce4b8602f26fb4d06e54fec56ed37126184.png"][/img]"Your tavern - your rules!"[/p][p]Set the laws of your tavern. The doorman will keep watch, and anyone breaking them gets tossed out quicker than a spilled beer.[/p][p]And if you feel like charging a shiny coin or two for entry - well, that's your right as a tavernkeeper![/p][p][/p][h2]The Blacksmith’s Wife Appears![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/5dd0444ccb74bd429ebee5f5f9cade710d666d45.png"][/img]She’s been watching from her window all this time.. and now, the door finally opens. Yes, you can visit the blacksmith’s wife at last. She’s more than just part of the ambience… let’s just say her company comes with a "certain charm"[/p][p][/p][p]Last but not least some bugfixes and smaller updates are included too.[/p][p]Here is a full list of the other changes:[/p][p][/p][h2]Updates[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a little well on the mainplace[/p][/*][*][p]You can now charge an entry fee for your tavern[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the height of street lamps[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the bank interests to 3% max[/p][/*][*][p]You don’t lose fame when kicking out unwanted guests who still have a drink[/p][/*][*][p]You don’t lose fame on starting fights when they have done something wrong[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to adjust the night brightness (specially for lower light settings)[/p][/*][*][p]Added 7 more skills[/p][/*][*][p]You lose fame when hitting innocent guests
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]More random names on reservations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug on storages, where you take the just stored items again when holding the mouse button[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug, where the sleeping widget (zZz) and the sound doesn’t disappear[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed used sitting places, when go sleeping and guests are still inside[/p][/*][*][p]Delivery guys now despawn if a delivery get lost and teleports to the tavern[/p][/*][*][p]Delivery guys won’t tell you anymore if the delivery arrives and you are not in the tavern[/p][/*][*][p]Spended coins will be taken from customers again[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the swing door rotation on the right barside[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the compass wasn’t shown after load outside of a tavern[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rotation of wall objects on the second floor[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some collisions with placing flowers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with workers when working more days in a row[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug, where quests with serving orders won’t count[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug, where strange events was shown in the calendar[/p][/*][*][p]New Level from workers is now hidden when they reached the maximum level[/p][/*][*][p]Some small fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Tavern Legends Is OUT NOW!

Whether you're serving tasty beer, cooking hearty stews, or keeping the rowdy guests in check with your trusty broom - the doors to [b]Tavern Legends[/b] are officially OPEN![/p][p][/p][h2]Important features[/h2][list][*][p]Build, expand, and decorate your own medieval taverns[/p][/*][*][p]Buy, upgrade, and manage up to four distinct taverns across the world—each with its own charm and challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Hire workers, which help you handling the daily madness in your tavern[/p][/*][*][p]Design and customize your taverns with total freedom! notes.title: Official Release Announcement – Tavern Legends launches July 4th!
notes.notes:
The time has come, innkeeper! After about 2 years of hard work, laughter, and spilled beer, Tavern Legends will officially open its Ealry Access doors on July 4th!

Become the keeper of your own medieval tavern in a lively and chaotic world where no two days (or customers) are the same.. build the tavern of your dreams, serve hearty meals and frothy drinks, and win the hearts (and gold) of peasants, guards, nobles, and even drunken mages.

Whether you’re sweeping floors, managing chaos, or just watching chickens roam freely through your tavern, Tavern Legends offers a cozy and lively simulation experience full of charm, physics-based fun, and unexpected moments.

The estimated price will be €24,50/$24.99
Tavern Legends is a handcrafted experience made with love by a solo developer. The price reflects the depth, attention to detail, and long-term support planned for the game. No microtransactions.
There are many ideas and features planned and upcoming on Early Access.

A chaotic tavern adventure you can enjoy at your own pace. Your support means everything. Thank you for being part of this journey!

See you at the bar,
[b]CROWFORGE Games[/b]

notes.title: Development News
notes.notes:
Greetings, innkeepers!

We’ve been hard at work bringing more life and chaos to your medieval tavern! Here’s what’s brewing in the latest updates:

New Points of Interests:

[h1]Marketplace[/h1]
The Marketplace is a bustling hub where players can buy fresh ingredients, restock supplies, and discover special items to enhance their tavern. It’s filled with merchants selling meats and vegetables for you meals. Prices vary so keep an eye to the market. You are also able to buy own market stalls for passive gold income.

[h3]Shops[/h3]
In shops you can buy mugs, plates, snacks and more tools for your tavern. Now deliveries have deliverycosts, so it is worth to visit them. Some items are available only in shops too.

[h3]Church[/h3]
Every medieval town needs a church, and Tavern Legends is no exception! Nestled beside it lies a misty cemetery, adding a touch of mystery to the town. Step inside the church, hear the priest’s solemn sermons, and immerse yourself in the rich atmosphere of medieval life.

[h3]Taverns[/h3]
Currently, the town offers four unique taverns - two smaller ones and two larger ones - all available for purchase. At the start of the game, you can choose one of the smaller taverns as your first step toward building your tavern empire!

[h1]More customers[/h1]
Added farmer, mages, knights and a king as a new class which visits your tavern.
Small description:
[list]
[*] farmers spend food instead of coins as a tip. It's class is a little bit lower than normal peasants
[*] Mages can cast evil or good spells depending on there ratings, which helps you in your tavern - or not
[*] Knights are a honered class, which spends a lot of tips. They will help you if rude customers starts a brawl in your tavern, even guards will help you with them
[*] The king may hold the highest title, but he’s also the most disgusting guest in the realm. Arrogant, gluttonous, and utterly shameless. His presence alone can send tavern cleanliness into chaos - but ignoring him might be even worse. However - the people of the town love him!
[/list]

[h1]Bookings[/h1]
With bookings, you can hire bards, run advertisements, and more to boost your tavern’s success. Each option costs a bit of gold, but in most cases, the investment pays off!

[h1]Skills[/h1]
Earn XP by cleaning your tavern, serving customers, and handling unruly guests, then go sleep to use your skill points. Spend them on character and management skills to unlock powerful upgrades that make running your tavern easier and more efficient!

[h1]Workers[/h1]
One of the most helpful features in Early Access is the addition of workers. You can hire them for each tavern to assist with cleaning, cooking, and serving your beloved customers. We're working hard to ensure this feature runs smoothly, making your tavern management easier than ever!

[h1]Micromanagement[/h1]
In the demo, things felt rushed, but Early Access changes that! The beginning will be calmer, with less chaos as you grow your tavern. Expanding and gaining fame will help your tavern evolve. Micromanagement is key - like using a rag to clean tables and experiencing class-dependent events, adding more depth to your daily operations.

[h1]Improvements in UI-Design and Settings[/h1]
The UI design has been completely revamped, offering a cleaner, more intuitive experience! Navigating menus, a map for orientation, managing your tavern and accessing important information is now smoother and more visually appealing than ever. 

We’ve also introduced more gameplay settings, allowing you to fine-tune your experience to match your preferences. From adjusting different soundsettings to customizing drinkspeed, manners and much more. you now have greater control over how you run your tavern and enjoy your journey in Tavern Legends.


We’re continuing to refine and expand Tavern Legends, so keep your feedback coming! What new features would you like to see? Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest on 6th - 13th February!
notes.notes:
[h1]Demo available![/h1]

The first beta-keys are out and there exists a small group of chosen testers which are available to play the game now. This Feedback will be used to fix most of the bugs on the demo and make the most out of it.

On 6th - 13th February at the Steam Next Fest there is a free demo of Tavern Legends available for all player who want to test the game. Dont miss this chance, you can give Feedback at the Steam communityhub and give feature request as much as you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/0739b3261973c8257bf2a5deaa61eeca0ddafb97.png[/img]

[h1]Whats in the demo?[/h1]

[h3]Service[/h3]
Full control of service, tapping, creating menus, bring to a customer and cleaning dishes and floors

[h3]Management[/h3]
Full management of the tavern. You can choose settings like music, opening times, costs of all orders, name your meals and drinks and much more

[h3]Building System[/h3]
You are able to build several buildings and customize your tavern as you want

[h3]Classes[/h3]
Beggars, Peasants and Guars
3 classes, which all has a difficult behavior

[h3]Menu[/h3]
Menues, from water to beer and also meals will be in the demo
You are able to serve all these menues to the customer

[h3]Menu creating[/h3]
Menu creating to bring creative menus alive which can be ordered

[h3]Leveling[/h3]
You can bring your tavern up to level 3, with all unlockable items and buildings
On level 3, the demo will be finished then - No time limit!

[h3]Music & Sound[/h3]
Full soundtracks and voices of the patrons

[h3]City[/h3]
A big area of the city is unlocked for the demo where you can go freely around the world


[h2]Whats not in the demo?[/h2]

[h3]Workers[/h3]
Its not possible to hire workers in the demo

[h3]Multiple Taverns[/h3]
You are not able to buy another tavern

[h3]Statistics[/h3]
No Statistics will be available in the demo like daily income, satisfaction of the customers etc

[h3]Game settings[/h3]
You are not able to change any ingame settings, like the maximum of patrons in the world or another gameplay changing settings

[h3]Random Events[/h3]
Random Events which can happen at certain times are not available

[h3]Limited classes[/h3]
Classes like Nobles, Mages, Princes and Kings are not available

notes.title: DEVBLOG 1
notes.notes:
[h1]DELIVERY[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/70bdd06d37e6770c149c50071a50d15be99ebe40.png[/img]
In your Tavern Menu you are able do make orders for your tavern. You can choose from mugs and plates to every ingredient which is needed for your meals. Set the delivery time to manage, when your delivery hast to arrive to your tavern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/072611f044da01484c0bba211605afa9ed38e4e0.png[/img]
A little cart comes to your tavern with all your ordered stuff. Depending on your ordered content, there are more or less boxes on the cart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/4cec346f41debbf4adf67ff35dc08ecb1898b4be.png[/img]
Adding your content to the taverns inventory by picking them up. Later you can store it in your shelfes directly from your tavern inventory

CLEANING
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/0739b3261973c8257bf2a5deaa61eeca0ddafb97.png[/img]
Keep your tavern clean! Each order must be cleaned after consuming. Every guest leaves also a little dirt on the floor by moving over it. Take your brush to clean it. On rainy days the dirt becomes much more than on sunny days.
Stay clean, this has an influence to the rating of your tavern.


GUARDS & NOBLES

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183620/0aa103f74401676a8a2efa02a405d66c870ec664.png[/img]
Now guards and nobles are implemented in the game. Guards are wearing bows or sword and shield. Nobles are the more delicated class which has more requirements than the normal peasants and guards.
